forces.title: 100% FDI boosts diamond and gemstone mining exploration
forces.description: The Indian government permits 100% Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) under the automatic route for exploration and mining of non-fuel and non-atomic minerals, specifically including diamonds and other precious stones. This policy serves as a significant tailwind for the Diamonds & Gemstones mining sector, as it lowers entry barriers for foreign investors and global entities to directly deploy capital into primary extraction and exploration activities. Increased access to international capital and expertise is expected to drive new project development, enhance exploration efforts, and bolster potential production capabilities for rough diamonds and gemstones in India.
